story: Tech stocks fell sharply after the internet bubble burst.
Banks and financial assets fell during the housing and credit crisis.
A sudden shutdown shocked the whole market, but some assets recovered faster than others.
Rising rates hurt growth stocks, bonds, and many assets that were supposed to diversify risk.
Banks became the fragile asset class, while parts of tech held up better.
Semiconductors, Bitcoin, and large tech became major winners in the new wealth cycle.
